correctness.how: A deterministic runner checks all declared storage decisions against the routed documentation, initializes a fresh Opportunity, verifies the readiness result, then removes identity metadata and requires readiness to fail.

cost.note: The runner has no model session, so tokens and dollars are not observable.

time.note: Harness duration is not agent elapsed time or human time saved.

with-skills.note: The runner exercises the shipped setup scripts and documentation contract.

baseline-no-skills.note: A deterministic script runner cannot represent an unaided model setup session.

coverage.rationale: Protect the established storage branches and readiness state transition.

trials.rationale: Each run uses a fresh synthetic workspace and deterministic state checks.

graders.rationale: Case-defined concepts establish that every supported storage branch remains represented without pinning exact prose.
Filesystem state and command exit codes directly grade setup completeness and the missing-identity failure.

skills_invoked.note: The harness invokes scripts, not an agent session.

clarifying_questions.note: The harness has no user turn.
